title: A_18k matches D_18k after a 1K bake; A keeps better geometry
what: Same UV recipe and bake settings. Metal+normal SSIM nearly equal (gem 0.867 vs 0.856, V-junction 0.898 vs 0.906). D geometry dev p99 0.90 mm vs A 0.25 mm.
cause: protecting the gem pulls triangles from the rest of the sword
fix: keep A (symmetric collapse + fold repair) at 18K

title: s3 smart-project UV gives 25-37% coverage, 600-800 islands and overlaps on an ornate sword
what: A_18k: coverage 0.253, 837 islands, 354 overlap px, 4 flipped tris; D_18k: 0.374, 610 islands, 541 overlap px
cause: Blender smart_project cuts at every 66 deg crease; the concave packer leaves gaps
fix: port the proven chart-growing + LSCM + FFT packer (74 % coverage) to numpy-only before the final s3

title: normal map on A_18k removes the old seam lines on the gem
what: metal + normal-only render of the gem is smooth like the high poly; no radial seam lines
cause: fresh decimation (10x more accurate) + hard edges only on seams + fixed baker

title: weapon fit was checked only after UV and bake work
what: The dragon sword went through low poly, UV and trial bakes before anyone measured whether it is a usable sword (mass 18 kg as steel, balance 13.6 cm behind the guard).
cause: no intake gate for weapon specs

title: a claim about geometry was made without measuring it
what: Claude said the current high poly kept the AI model's dimensions. Measured: overall 1.184 -> 1.258 m, grip 0.148 -> 0.201 m, blade section 2109 -> 699 mm2, mass 25 -> 18 kg.
cause: statement from memory, not from a measurement
fix: measure original vs current with the same s0_spec code before stating anything

title: the grip edit made the grip fit two hands
what: Original AI grip 14.8 cm (1.66 hand breadths, REVIEW for a longsword); after the v13/v17 edits 20.1 cm (>= 17.8 cm for two hands, PASS).

title: a module was rebuilt without auditing the existing studio code
what: forge_specs re-implemented mass/balance while <home>/Blender_AI_Studio/scripts/mass_balance.py already existed with sourced ranges and the agreed rule 'fantasy = warning band only'. Result: fantasy swords were wrongly FAILed on weight.
cause: no audit of the older studio before building
fix: spec_checks follows the agreed rule; balance ranges taken from mass_balance.py; audit existing modules before adding new ones

title: the AI model's own normal texture was baked into the game normal map
what: Selected-to-active NORMAL bake samples the high poly's shading normal, including the AI material's blocky normal texture: grain, specks and broken highlights on dragon v2 (metal+normal SSIM 0.803). Geometry-only normal bake: 0.915 (gem area 0.66 -> 0.88, guard back 0.69 -> 0.92); normal-map roughness p99 0.505 -> 0.079.
cause: AI GLB materials connect a NORMAL_MAP node to the Principled BSDF
fix: baker cuts the Normal input of the high materials during the Normal pass (normal_from='geometry')

title: a plausible cause was tested before it was believed
what: Ray length (4/12 mm vs 1.5/3 mm) was the first hypothesis for the speckles; measured, it changed nothing (0.8032 vs 0.8031). The real cause was found next.
fix: always A/B one variable with the same metrics

title: thin_profile protected the gem with a sphere that was not centred on the gem: the lower half of the socket was pushed in (pearl looks flat / half sunk, wavy ring)
what: Dragon v2, edit thin_blade_guard (blade x0.4, guard x0.5). protect_zones [[0,0,0.86,0.05]] was guessed from the guard centre. The gem socket measured afterwards is centred at z 0.826 (r 0.038). Everything below z ~0.81 and the lower sides of the socket and ring were thinned: ring p5 -11.7 mm, gem face p5 -6.4 mm, while the top stayed: upper half proud, lower half sunk, a wavy step along the sphere boundary. The user saw it in the viewport.
cause: protect zone written from an estimate, never measured on the mesh and never checked with a before/after difference map; Claude first told the user the flat gem came from the AI model after checking only the centre line (x=0), which was inside the sphere
fix: measure each protected part from the geometry (circle fit to the socket wall) before an edit; after every geometry edit render a difference map of the protected parts and compare inside/outside the zone. For the dragon v2 (user: do not re-run the stages) the gem is drawn as a round pearl in the textures (gem_dome normals).
gate: planned: thin_profile / thin_zone FAIL when a protected part changes or when the change map has a step inside a part's measured outline

title: Preview bake 2K + smart UV 80 deg loosens the s2 look gate: rejected (code unchanged)
what: Tried on copies (projects untouched) to fix silver_fang's look_excess FAIL (tip 0.052). Deterministic (base twice identical). angle 80 alone: tip 0.042; 2K alone: worst 0.023; 2K+80: worst 0.0126 (guard_center). But the same change made the 16k candidates of green_sword (0.0142 -> 0.0087) and crimson_lava_dagger (0.0146 -> 0.0074) pass, which the calibrated 1K gate rejects; green 16k vs 22k no longer separated (0.0087 vs 0.0083). island_margin 0.008 worse; ray/cage x2 no effect.
cause: a sharper preview lowers the error floor of every candidate; emax 0.010 was calibrated on the 1K preview
fix: not adopted. A different preview would need a new calibration of look_excess_p95_max on several swords x candidates.
